content.title: Clinical Labs Hope to Head Off Looming Medicare Cuts
content.summary: FEATURE  U.S. House representatives heard the clinical lab industry plead yesterday for a reprieve from looming cuts as large as 15% in what Medicare pays Labcorp Holdings Quest Diagnostics and cancer-testing specialists like Guardant Health Exact Sciences and Natera  Starting February, a current law will require labs to tell Medicare the rates that private insurers paid for tests back in 2019.
